steps.en: Daily run sends IDs out, receives particulars, then starts the reports
steps.id: Run harian mengirim ID, menerima particulars, lalu memulai laporan
steps.why_en: The foreigner and company run is switched off in the production settings, and the run is three times a day, not daily.
steps.why_id: Run untuk warga asing dan perusahaan dimatikan di setting production, dan jalannya tiga kali sehari, bukan harian.

steps.en: MHA report shows records sent, received and failed
steps.id: Laporan MHA menampilkan record terkirim, diterima, dan gagal
steps.why_en: A known open defect makes the production counts show zero and the report goes out twice.
steps.why_id: Ada defect terbuka yang membuat angka di production nol dan laporan terkirim dua kali.

steps.en: Company report shows IDs sent and not found, per stage
steps.id: Laporan perusahaan menampilkan ID terkirim dan tidak ditemukan, per stage

steps.en: Foreigner report shows IDs sent and not found, per stage
steps.id: Laporan warga asing menampilkan ID terkirim dan tidak ditemukan, per stage

steps.en: Failed and not-found records are listed in the report
steps.id: Record gagal dan tidak ditemukan tercantum di laporan

steps.en: OIC can download the reports from the portal
steps.id: OIC bisa mengunduh laporan dari portal
steps.why_en: Reports sit on a general reports page, and access for the two new report types may be blocked.
steps.why_id: Laporan ada di halaman laporan umum, dan akses untuk dua jenis laporan baru bisa terblokir.
